description: This file defines the ReportingMethod entity class for the OrangeHRM application, mapping it to the 'ohrm_emp_reporting_method' database table. It includes properties for the reporting method's ID and name, as well as a collection of 'ReportTo' associated entities. The class provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: ReportingMethod
classes.description: Entity class representing a reporting method for employees, with properties for ID, name, and associated report links.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reporting method.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reporting method.
